cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm and pivots its forearm and hand back and forth to create a classic waving gesture, commonly used for greeting.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot raises its arm in a classic gesture of acknowledgement or greeting, holds it briefly at the peak, and then lowers it back to a neutral position.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm moves forward and down from a neutral position, holds the pose to show respect or greeting, and then returns to the starting position.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position into a ready stance, then extends forward with a vertically-oriented gripper to offer a handshake, holding the final pose to await interaction.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertically oriented gripper, performs a small, repetitive up-and-down motion to simulate a handshake, and then returns to a neutral position.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves across its body to simulate a self-hug, holds the position, gives a gentle squeeze to convey comfort or self-soothing, and then returns to a neutral position.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot arm brings its gripper to its 'mouth' area, pauses as if kissing its fingertips, and then extends forward in a gentle blowing motion, finishing with a slight flourish.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm moves to a central position high up, then traces the shape of a large heart in the air to express love or affection.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot arm moves inward to place its gripper over the center of its chest, holding the pose to convey sincerity, gratitude, or a solemn promise.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm starts from a neutral position, quickly raises its fist high into the air in a classic victory or celebration gesture, holds it for a moment, and then returns to rest.

cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a friendly waving position, pivots its wrist side-to-side several times in a 'hello' gesture, and then returns to a neutral resting position.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot raises its arm in a clear, upward motion from the shoulder and elbow, holds it momentarily to greet or acknowledge someone, and then returns to a neutral position.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm starts from a neutral position, performs a slow, respectful bow by tilting forward and down from the shoulder, holds the bow briefly, and then returns to the starting stance.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertical gripper, as if offering a handshake, holds the position expectantly, and then retracts to a neutral position.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertically oriented gripper, as if to offer a handshake, and then performs a short, repetitive up-and-down motion to simulate the shake.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves across its body, simulating a self-hug. It gently pats the opposite shoulder a few times as a gesture of comfort before returning to a neutral position.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot brings its gripper to its 'mouth' area, pauses as if to kiss its fingertips, and then extends its arm forward and slightly upward to 'blow' the kiss.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm moves to a high central position and then traces the two lobes of a large heart shape in the air, creating a universally recognized symbol of love.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position to place its gripper over its central chest area, holding it there to convey sincerity, gratitude, or taking an oath. It then returns to a resting position.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm starts low, then quickly thrusts upward into a triumphant fist-pump pose, holds it, and gives a slight shake to express victory or excitement before returning to a neutral position.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot arm raises and bends, then quickly pumps downward one or more times to express success, excitement, or agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot raises its arm and bends the elbow to mimic flexing a bicep, conveying a sense of strength or encouragement.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot arm moves its gripper up and down in a repetitive motion, similar to a person nodding their head to signify 'yes' or agreement.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot arm moves to a central position and rotates its gripper side to side, mimicking a head shake to signify 'no'.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot raises its arm with the gripper facing up, performs a quick upward lift of the shoulder to mimic a shrug, and then returns to a neutral position, conveying uncertainty or a lack of knowledge.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, performs a light, repetitive scratching motion with its wrist, and then returns to a neutral position, signaling confusion or thought.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot positions its arm in a neutral, head-like posture, then slowly tilts the gripper to one side and holds it, mimicking a curious head tilt to express interest or confusion.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot brings its hand up to its face, palm inward, to convey frustration, disappointment, or exasperation. It holds the pose briefly before returning to a neutral position.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position to its chest, pointing the gripper tip inward to indicate 'me'. It holds the pose briefly before returning to a resting state.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertically oriented gripper, performs a short, sharp jab to emphasize pointing at something or someone, then returns to a neutral position.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm with the palm facing upward, then repeatedly curls its wrist and elbow inward in a classic 'come here' or beckoning gesture.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot arm moves assertively to extend forward with a vertical gripper, holding the iconic 'stop' hand signal. The pose is held to emphasize the command before the arm retracts to a neutral position.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot raises its arm and points its gripper upward, as if raising an index finger to signal 'one moment' or to make an important point. It holds the pose briefly before returning to a neutral position.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its arm to its 'face', placing the gripper tip near its 'lips' in a vertical orientation to signal 'shh' or 'be quiet', then returns to a neutral position.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its arm to its midsection with the gripper horizontal, then performs several light patting motions to indicate hunger or fullness before returning to a neutral state.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm moves across the chest to rub one upper arm, then the other, mimicking the human gesture for feeling cold.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its hand to its face and pivots the wrist back and forth rapidly, mimicking the motion of fanning oneself to cool down.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot arm moves its gripper to its 'mouth' area. It performs a slow, upward motion to simulate a yawn, then holds the position as if covering its mouth before returning to rest.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot brings its gripper to the side of its head and traces small circles, as if rubbing a tired eye.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral position at its side, then performs a slow, deep bow by extending forward and downward. It holds the lowest point of the bow to convey sincerity and respect, before slowly returning to the initial stance.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises one hand to shoulder height, with the gripper oriented vertically. It then performs two quick, small wrist flicks to mimic the 'air quotes' gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to its temple, performs several quick taps with its index finger, and holds the pose to signify thinking or having an idea.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head and makes small, continuous circular motions with its wrist, mimicking the 'crazy' or 'thinking' gesture.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot arm raises to the 'mouth' area, performs a quick horizontal swipe to mimic zipping the lips, and holds to signify keeping a secret.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot arm moves from its side, lifts to chest level, and then sweeps across the body into a crossed position, holding it to convey a defensive or closed-off stance.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves sharply to a low, lateral position, mimicking a hand placed on the hip. The pose is held to convey a sense of confidence, defiance, or annoyance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot arm extends forward from a neutral position with the gripper held horizontally, mimicking open palms. It holds this engaging posture to show interest, then retracts.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot recoils sharply, raising its gripper in a defensive 'hands up' gesture. It trembles slightly before holding the pose to convey shock or surprise.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly brings its gripper to its 'mouth' area in a gesture of surprise or realization, holds it there briefly, and then lowers its arm.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its arm to a central, prayer-like position, then performs a slow, deliberate bow to express gratitude or respect.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot raises its arm as if holding a glass, pauses, then performs a short, quick forward motion to simulate a 'cheers' or toasting gesture.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot raises its arm and presents its palm forward in a classic 'high five' gesture, holding the pose expectantly.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm with the gripper oriented vertically, like an open palm, then performs a swift downward swing to simulate a high-five before returning to the ready position.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a closed gripper, presenting a fist to request a fist bump, holds the position, and then retracts.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot brings its arm forward into a fist bump position, then performs a light, double-tapping motion as if bumping another fist.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot raises its arm over its shoulder and gently pats its own back in a gesture of self-encouragement or praise.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot raises its arm and points forward, then traces two circles in the air with its wrist to indicate repetition or a circular concept.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its hand to its throat with the gripper held horizontally, then performs a quick, sharp slice across the front of its body to signal 'cut it' or 'stop'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot arm brings its gripper under its chin, then performs a quick outward flick, conveying a sense of dismissal or indifference, before returning to a neutral position.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot arm moves to a low, forward position as if resting on a table, then performs a repetitive, rapid tapping motion with its wrist to simulate drumming fingers, conveying boredom or impatience.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm with the palm facing up, then repeatedly curls its fingers inward in a 'give me' or 'come here' gesture.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm extends forward and slightly upward, with the gripper oriented horizontally (palm up), to present or offer something in a steady, deliberate manner.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot raises its arm upward and outward to a position beside its 'head'. It gives a slight exasperated shake and holds the pose to signify surrender or 'I give up'. This cue represents one arm's motion in a two-armed gesture.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its 'head', placing the gripper over its 'ear' as if to block out loud noise. It holds this position and shakes slightly before returning to rest.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot arm starts from a position near its body and sweeps outward in a wide, welcoming arc, holding the final open-armed position to express a gesture of welcome or embrace.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot arm moves slowly upward to its highest point, holds the stretch to signify relief, and then returns to a relaxed, neutral position.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral resting position to a formal salute, with the gripper held vertically near the forehead. After a brief hold, the arm returns to the initial position.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot raises its arm, placing the gripper above its 'eyes' like a visor. It then slowly pans its arm side-to-side, mimicking the action of scanning the horizon or searching for something in the distance.

cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a friendly waving position, pivots its wrist side-to-side several times, and then returns to a neutral stance.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position upward to a high position, holds briefly to signal a greeting or acknowledgement, and then returns to a lowered, resting state.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm performs a slow, deliberate forward and downward movement from the shoulder, simulating a respectful bow. It holds the lowest point briefly before returning to a neutral stance.
